Tether is hiring multiple roles worldwide

We are a globally distributed, internet-native team of engineers, researchers, creators and builders working on technologies that scale to billions. We have zero interest in corporate red tape. We move fast, we ship industry-defining products, and we are fiercely dedicated to decentralization. If you are a brilliant builder ready to tackle foundational platforms in AI, finance, energy, and peer-to-peer tech, join us.

Apply now to join us:
